messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — latency SLO breach for dedicated pool syzygy-eu-west-1 (customer: Syzygy Inc). p95=1.2s (SLO=300ms), p99=4.8s. Throughput high. Error rate within baseline. Paging on-call SRE.

Alex (SRE): I'm on it. Starting triage now. Jordan, any config changes or autoscaler events in the last 30m?

Jordan (Prod Ops): Not from autoscaler. I see a surge in request concurrency to that pool starting ~8222222800. No deploys in last hour.

Sam (Runtime Eng): Pulling pool metrics and tail logs. Running quick inspect: 
```
rwctl pool describe syzygy-eu-west-1 --json | jq '.throughput,.latency.p95,.latency.p99,.hot_tenants[0:5]'
```
Output snippet: 
```
throughput: 420 rps
latency.p95: 1.2s
latency.p99: 4.8s
hot_tenants: ["tenant-17", "tenant-42", "tenant-9"]
```

Lina (Support): Syzygy CS reported increased request times for their /api/generate route ~15m ago. They've noticed degraded UX for some accounts. CSM says they're watching.

Alex (SRE): Pattern looks like tenant-local noisiness. Sam — can you confirm tail of KV/cache misses? Also check GPU utilization and queue lengths on the pool nodes.

Sam (Runtime Eng): Cache miss rate spiked for tenant-17, KV eviction churn high. GPU util 95% on two nodes, queues growing. Suggest isolating tenant-17 or throttling at ingress to stop herd.

Jordan (Prod Ops): I can apply throttling policy to that pool. Propose 50% concurrency cap for tenant-17 and start tenant eviction if needed.

Alex (SRE): Do isolation now. Use the safe command: 
```
rwctl tenant throttle --pool syzygy-eu-west-1 --tenant tenant-17 --concurrency 0.5
rwctl tenant evict --pool syzygy-eu-west-1 --tenant tenant-17 --grace-period 30s
```

Jordan (Prod Ops): Executing throttle... done. Eviction queued (30s grace). Monitoring. :white_check_mark:

Sam (Runtime Eng): After throttle: p95 dropped to 420ms, p99 to 900ms within 90s. Node queues decreasing. GPU back to ~78%. Cache miss rate falling.

Lina (Support): Notifying Syzygy CSM and engineer contact Ryan that transient impact mitigation in place, asking for any internal spikes.

Ryan (Customer Eng): Acknowledged — I've pinged Syzygy lead. They saw a lift in a specific campaign hitting tenant-17 — they'll throttle on their side too. Thanks team.

Maya (PM): Good mitigation. Can we confirm no data loss and capture a post-incident summary? CSM wants ETA to return to normal baseline.

Alex (SRE): No errors introduced by eviction. We'll keep pool at current throttle for 10m, then remove and monitor. Postmortem will include root cause: noisy tenant traffic pattern + cache churn leading to GPU scheduling degradation.

Jordan (Prod Ops): Scheduled rollback of throttle at 8222224533 unless we see regression. I'll leave warm spare ready: eu-central-warm is standing by if we need regional failover.

Sam (Runtime Eng): Creating short-term alert to catch recurrent KV churn: 
```
alert create --name kv-churn-high --expr 'kv_miss_rate > 5% and p99 > 1s' --window 5m
```

Alex (SRE): Marking incident as mitigated at 8222223633. Customer-impacting window ~8222222800–8222223633. Follow-ups: 1) Postmortem + timeline, 2) Auto-throttle rule for tenants exceeding X rps or cache churn, 3) Discuss capacity shielding for enterprise dedicated pools.

Lina (Support): I'll draft the customer-facing note and share with Ryan for approval.

Ryan (Customer Eng): Will coordinate and send update to Syzygy. Thanks all. :pray:

Maya (PM): Thanks team. We'll add a tactical playbook for noisy-tenant eviction to runbook.

IncidentBot: Incident status -> mitigated; severity lowered. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/noisy-tenant-eviction
